comment: Only an acute admission: "Se ingresó en Nefrología con el diagnóstico de IRA prerrenal", resolved (creatinine 0,86 at discharge) with no ongoing Nephrology follow-up described.

The sentence says the CKD was "en seguimiento hasta entonces por nefrología pediátrica", and the case continues with dialysis and a transplant with periodic visits ("acudiendo periódicamente a la consulta de TX.Renal"), so she is followed by Nephrology; the sentence alone is past tense, which is the only doubt.
"en control por nefrología infantil" states ongoing paediatric Nephrology follow-up for renal angiomyolipomas in tuberous sclerosis.
"efectuar seguimiento en la consulta externa de Nefrología" for residual proteinuria, and the text later refers to "repetidos estudios a lo largo del seguimiento".
